calls.title: Ravindra Nagaraju and Cary Rakin
calls.summary: The meeting discussed the renewal of the contract with no major changes, maintaining 250 full-access and 25 read-only licenses, aiming for budget approval by June 12. Cary and Ravi committed to delivering renewal numbers and an order form by June 9 to facilitate internal reviews. They addressed price flexibility options with a tiered pricing model for potential seat increases, and discussed premium support terms, including a 30-minute response time and a 2-hour restore time but noted the lack of consulting services. A strong emphasis was placed on enhancing the partnership through proactive collaboration and the scheduling of quarterly business reviews, alongside clear communication to ensure service continuity during the renewal process.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, contract renewal, license usage, procurement, premium support, enterprise migration
calls.action_items:
**Cary Rakin**
Provide Ravi with a query or method to check seat/license usage on GrowthBook self-hosted system (08:12)
Prepare and deliver contract renewal pricing numbers and order form by Tuesday, June 9th, for review with Ravi and team (11:10)
Send detailed email to Ravi summarizing the contract’s support terms and clarify scope of premium support versus consulting (19:40)
Be available for a meeting at 8:30 AM Pacific Time on June 9th to review renewal details (14:30)
Continue proactive communications and provide QBR/ROI presentations to aid internal advocacy for GrowthBook adoption (16:10)

**Ravi Nagaraju**
Confirm license seat usage by checking active members and communicate findings back to Cary (08:30)
Set up renewal budgetary review meeting with key stakeholders by June 9th at 8:30 AM Pacific Time (14:15)
Coordinate with procurement after receiving renewal numbers and contract details from Cary (24:00)
Share procurement contacts with Cary post-initial renewal discussions (23:45)
